About Bay Breeze Realty

Our Story

Real estate guidance without the sales pressure

Bay Breeze Realty was born out of a simple frustration: watching eager, hardworking first-time buyers get outbid, overwhelmed, and left behind by traditional corporate brokerages. Founded by two former educators, our firm brings a classroom-tested approach to the East Bay market, prioritizing plain-English answers and zero jargon.

We specialize in helping buyers navigate Alameda, Oakland, and surrounding waterfront communities with confidence. Instead of high-pressure sales pitches, we focus on education. From our monthly library workshops to weekend open house crawl tours, we treat real estate as an empowering journey.

We are deeply rooted in the East Bay, combining hyper-local market expertise with a neighborhood-first vibe. Whether you are hunting for a historic Victorian or trying to make sense of your first offer, we are here to help you every step of the way.
